title: What's New in Kotlin Jump
tagline: Dead-code fixes that delete only the dead code
summary: Kotlin Jump 1.42.11 audits the edits the dead-code family writes. A removal that could climb to the licence header, a catalog fix that broke the next alias, a "Delete file" offered on a file a test still needs, offsets computed on the disk copy of a file you were editing, and a manifest removal that stopped at the first child tag.

highlights.title: Removal extents that stay put
highlights.description: A /* warm */ at the end of the line above made "Delete unreferenced …" climb to the licence header. The extent now walks only through comment-only lines, skips annotation lines that declare something of their own, and this feeds the member, island and "Delete file" fixes too.

highlights.title: Catalog and file deletions that keep the build green
highlights.description: A shared [versions] entry is freed only by its last referrer, "Delete X.kt" is offered only when nothing test-only remains in it, and a Remove All never mixes a file deletion with a text edit on the same file.

highlights.title: Edits on the text you see
highlights.description: The corpus reads open editors with unsaved changes, so offsets match the document instead of the disk copy. A manifest component is removed whole, comments inside the import block survive Organize Imports, and Smart Join moves a trailing comment after the chain.

sections.heading: Fixes
bullets: The Remote Config quick fix title says it edits this file only, and "Find Everything Unused" runs the symbol scan once instead of twice.
